events.summary: Anthropic announced its Claude Opus 5.5 flagship model on Sep 22, 2026.
events.headline: Introducing Claude Opus 5.5

events.summary: Anthropic announced its Claude Sonnet 5.5 model on Sep 28, 2026.
events.headline: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5.5

events.summary: Per IPO filing disclosures, Broadcom agreed to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion for infrastructure, which could finance about one-third of Anthropic's $125.2 billion five-year TPU lease commitment and could convert into Anthropic equity.
events.headline: Broadcom to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion to lease its chips, filing says

events.summary: Anthropic announced a $100 million commitment (Claude Frontier Academy) to train 10,000 engineers on Oct 2, 2026.
events.headline: Anthropic invests $100 million to train 10,000 engineers and tackle the enterprise AI talent gap

events.summary: Anthropic announced the Claude Haiku 5.5 model, with its own performance and pricing sections, on Oct 7, 2026.
events.headline: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5

events.summary: Anthropic launched the Anthropic Cyber Mission, a new security program, on Oct 8, 2026.
events.headline: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission

events.summary: Anthropic opened a Singapore office — its expansion into Southeast Asia — and signed an MOU with the Government of Singapore, published Oct 14, 2026.
events.headline: Anthropic opens Singapore office and signs MOU with the Government of Singapore

events.summary: Physicist Christopher Stubbs was appointed to Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, announced Oct 21, 2026.
events.headline: Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust

events.summary: Anthropic announced it is donating its Agent Skills technology to the Agentic AI Foundation, announced Oct 22, 2026.
events.headline: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation

events.summary: Anthropic formally filed its Form S-1 with the SEC on Oct 26, 2026 for a proposed IPO that press reports say could value it at up to $2 trillion.
events.headline: Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for proposed initial public offering

events.summary: Anthropic announced an expanded partnership with the US General Services Administration to bring Claude to all levels of government, Oct 27, 2026.
events.headline: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government

events.summary: Anthropic expanded its AI for Science program to 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research organizations, Oct 28, 2026.
events.headline: AI for Science expands to foundations and research institutions

events.summary: On Oct 30, 2026 Anthropic renamed its Claude subscription plans — Max 5x is now 'Max' and Max 20x is now 'Ultra' — with prices unchanged at $100/month for Max and $200/month for Ultra.
events.headline: Anthropic renames Claude Max plans: Max 5x becomes Max, Max 20x becomes Ultra

events.summary: Anthropic filed an amended S-1 with Q3 2026 financials on Nov 2, 2026, reporting $17 billion in Q3 revenue and $895.4 billion in purchase commitments.
events.headline: Anthropic reports $17 billion in Q3 revenue, purchase commitments of $895.4 billion in revised S-1

events.summary: Cat Wu, head of product for Claude Code, left Anthropic on Friday Nov 1 (article published Nov 3, 2026), announcing her departure on X ahead of the company's IPO.
events.headline: Cat Wu, a face of the blockbuster app Claude Code, leaves Anthropic
